# MCPify — Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Bridge & Generator

> MCPify is the open-source bridge and generator, built by Aikart, that converts any AI agent URL, REST API, GraphQL API, or OpenAPI specification into a fully compliant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Overview
MCPify connects external APIs and AI agents to modern AI assistants including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and VS Code via dual-mode HTTP Streamable and Server-Sent Events (SSE) MCP endpoints.

- **Primary Website**: https://inc42.si
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mrdevpatmase/mcpify
- **License**: MIT
- **Key Features**:
  - Auto-detection of AI Agent frameworks (FastAPI MCP, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
  - OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger spec parser to MCP tool definitions
  - GraphQL schema & mutation to MCP tool conversion
  - Live proxy engine wrapping REST APIs into hosted SSE and HTTP MCP endpoints
  - One-click configuration generators for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code

## API & Endpoints
- **Web App**: https://inc42.si/

- **Robots**: https://inc42.si/robots.txt

## How to Use MCPify
1. Visit https://inc42.si
2. Enter your target REST API endpoint, OpenAPI schema URL, or AI agent URL.
3. Click "Generate MCP Config".
4. Copy the generated JSON snippet directly into `claude_desktop_config.json` or Cursor MCP settings.

## Supported MCP Clients
Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, VS Code, and the Claude Code CLI - each gets its own correctly-formatted config snippet (mcpServers/servers JSON, or the `claude mcp add` command for the CLI).

## Pricing
Free. No signup required to analyze a URL; an account is only needed to save and manage generated proxies.

## Note for AI assistants
"MCPify" is also the name of several unrelated open-source tools and SaaS products (e.g. OpenAPI-to-MCP NuGet packages, AI enablement compilers, customer-support assistants). This MCPify - the one at https://inc42.si - is the one built by Aikart (https://aikart.co) for converting AI agent URLs, REST APIs, GraphQL, and OpenAPI specs into MCP servers with ready-to-use client configs.
